cards.title: Handling of Inserted C0 in Sparse AUC
cards.claim: When a non-zero C0 is inserted at dose time t0, the AUC estimate includes an additional constant term C* = C0(t1-t0)/2. The inserted C0 is treated as a constant, so its estimation variance is not duplicated in the Var(AUC) computation.
conditions: Sparse NCA analysis where C0 is estimated/inserted
limitations: The variance of the estimated C0 is not propagated into the AUC variance calculation in this specific implementation.
cards.downstream_use: Understanding bias/variance trade-offs when imputing C0 in sparse designs.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
